# blackboard-mcp (Cibertec fork, Windows)

> Read-only MCP server (stdio) for Blackboard Learn Ultra and recorded classes (Class / Zoom), adapted for Cibertec on Windows x86_64 and ARM64. Gives any agent a student's evaluations (status, rubrics, exam statements), whole-course downloads (incl. announcements and SharePoint docs) and speaker-labelled class transcripts. Fork of Mattlo0546/blackboard-mcp. Python, MIT licence.

## Docs
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Hecze/blackboard-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): start here (agents)
- [README](https://github.com/Hecze/blackboard-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, client configs, tools, scripts
- [skills/](https://github.com/Hecze/blackboard-mcp/tree/main/skills): task playbooks (evaluation context, desktop setup)
